_comment: The shape of the trip JSON that lives in the server storage (/api/trip-data). This is only an example — the real trip is never committed to this public repo. Easiest way in: paste JSON like this into Settings → Trip data inside the app and hit save. Or from a terminal: curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Tabi-Password: YOUR_PASSWORD' --data @trip-data.json https://YOUR-SITE.netlify.app/api/trip-data
